J&K High Court Bans Fuel-Powered Boats on Dal Lake

The Jammu and Kashmir High Court has banned fuel-powered motorboats and jet skis on the Dal Lake. The court also urged for the adoption of eco-friendly alternatives. The ban specifically includes fuel-driven shikaras.
